verdict.rationale: Rippling documents a public v2 REST API with Bearer-token auth, scoped permissions, dated versioning, cursor pagination, an npm SDK, and an official MCP server, so programmatic access clearly exists. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers the IT product's UI capabilities (device management, identity/access rules, inventory, workflows); the only concrete endpoint cited is List companies. Missing for 10: any statement or evidence of UI/API parity, documented IT-specific endpoints for devices, access policies, inventory, and workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API coverage.
